heroicmap.angebot.keins: This server offers no map to download.
heroicmap.angebot.unlesbar: The server's offer cannot be read.
heroicmap.befehl.unbekannt: The map %s is not offered here.
heroicmap.befehl.massstab: No such scale; 1, 2 or 4 pixels per block.
heroicmap.befehl.massstab_fehlt: The server does not offer this scale for the map: %s px.
heroicmap.befehl.kein_satz: Nothing of the map %s is on disk yet; use /hmap laden first.
heroicmap.befehl.frage: %s: up to %s at %s pixels per block. A full download counts against the server's limit, 5 per week by default; saying no costs nothing.
heroicmap.befehl.frage_wechsel: %s: up to %s at %s pixels per block. A full download counts against the server's limit, 5 per week by default; saying no costs nothing. Your map at %s px is removed once the new one is complete.
heroicmap.download.titel: Download the map from the server?
heroicmap.download.frage: The game server %s offers the map from %s. It needs up to %s on disk, at %s pixels per block. The mod downloads data from this host.
heroicmap.download.host: The game server %s has the map downloaded from %s. The mod downloads data from this host.
heroicmap.download.fertig: Map downloaded: %s new, %s already there, %s removed, %s.
heroicmap.download.gekappt: Map partly downloaded: %s new, %s already there, %s removed, %s. The rest comes with the next sync or a full download.
heroicmap.download.belegt: A download for the map %s is already waiting or running.
heroicmap.download.verfaellt_belegt: A download for the map %s is already waiting or running; the new release lapses.
heroicmap.download.verfaellt_dialog: A dialog is already open; the release for %s lapses.
heroicmap.download.nicht_angeboten: The server releases a map it does not offer: %s.
heroicmap.download.abgelehnt_wieder: The server declines: %s Possible again from %s.
heroicmap.download.unlesbar: The server's release cannot be read.
heroicmap.download.grund.pruefsumme: The manifest does not match the release.
heroicmap.download.grund.manifest: Manifest or map.json break a limit.
heroicmap.download.grund.abgelehnt: The map server declines the token.
heroicmap.download.grund.budget: This download's budget is used up; the rest comes with the next sync.
heroicmap.download.grund.netz: No, an incomplete or a wrong answer from the map server.
heroicmap.download.grund.heimnetz: The map is in a private network and not on the game server itself; the mod downloads nothing.
heroicmap.download.grund.unbekannt: The map's host does not exist.
heroicmap.download.grund.anderer: An error in the mod; details in the log.
heroicmap.download.grund.strom: The map server's stream breaks a rule; details in the log.
heroicmap.tafel.keine_antwort: No answer from the server yet
heroicmap.karte.keine: No map is downloaded for this dimension; /hmap angebot shows what the server offers.
heroicmap.verwaltung.ebene.tooltip: Click: into the next own layer
heroicmap.verwaltung.sortierung.name: Name
heroicmap.karte.ebene_voll: %s not pinned: at most %s regions and %s pins and banners
heroicmap.teleport.kein_recht: Teleport: the server doesn't allow you /tp.
heroicmap.teleport.frist: Teleport cancelled: the server did not send the destination within 5 seconds. You are back where you were.
heroicmap.teleport.kein_platz: Teleport cancelled: there is no place to stand at the destination. You are back where you were.
heroicmap.karte.name: Name…
heroicmap.karte.name_hinweis: Enter: save the name, empty for none; Esc cancels
heroicmap.karte.farbe_hinweis: Enter: save the color as #RRGGBB, empty for the list color; Esc cancels
heroicmap.karte.form_weg: This shape has changed or is gone; the new corners were not saved
heroicmap.karte.form_hinweis: Left-click: corner here or on a waypoint, on the first one: region; right-click: finish; Esc cancels
heroicmap.karte.angeheftet_voll: At most %s regions pinned; unpin one first
heroicmap.karte.nadeln_voll: At most %s pins and banners pinned; unpin one first
heroicmap.download.abgleich_ab: The next sync is possible from %s.
heroicmap.menue.aufloesung.beschreibung: Minimap resolution: how many pixels per block it draws at most
heroicmap.menue.ziehen: Drag to move the minimap, drag the handle to resize it. Click yourself to change how you look, click a mark to change the frame.
heroicmap.menue.show.grund.plugin: This server lacks the Heroic Map plugin; other players do not work here.
heroicmap.menue.show.grund.permission: The server does not allow you other players on the map.
heroicmap.menue.show.grund.simplevoicech: Simple Voice Chat is missing on the server.
heroicmap.menue.show.grund.sonst: The server declines other players on the map.
heroicmap.liste.frage: %s with %s will be removed from disk. You only get it back with a new download.
heroicmap.liste.belegt: A download into this map is running.
heroicmap.liste.fehler: The map was not fully deleted; see the log for details.
heroicmap.alte.text: On %s the map already shows “%s” for %s, %s, %s px, %s.
heroicmap.alte.text_ohne: The map already shows “%s” for %s, %s, %s px, %s.
heroicmap.alte.hinweis: If you keep it, it rests here and you can switch it back on in the map list. Delete removes it from disk.
heroicmap.alte.danach_selbst: After that the mod draws your own map at %s px.
heroicmap.alte.danach_download: After that the mod asks about the download.
heroicmap.selbst.wieder_an: Your own map is on again; the download rests.
heroicmap.auswahl.ruht.beschreibung: This map rests on this server and gets no sync. Switch it on in the map list.
heroicmap.download.ruht: %s rests on this server; switch it on in the map list to sync it.
heroicmap.liste.uebernehmen.beschreibung: This own map comes from a server without a name, for example from before 0.2.69. Taking it over makes it the own map of %s.
heroicmap.liste.ort.nicht: Maps of the storage before the hash don't move; without a hash there is no place.
heroicmap.ort.mit: With %s maps, waypoints and map view.
heroicmap.ort.bleiben: Waypoints and map view stay in the old folder.
heroicmap.ort.eigene: Your own map then belongs to %s.
heroicmap.ort.eigene.ohne: Your own map then belongs to a server without a name.
heroicmap.ort.da: Something is already there; nothing gets merged.
heroicmap.ort.hier: That is the folder of the world you are in; leave the world first.
heroicmap.ort.selbst: “Draw it yourself” is drawing in this world right now.
heroicmap.ort.gezeigt: The minimap and the full map are showing this map right now; leave the world first or show another map.
heroicmap.ort.nicht_gefunden: No save with this name; the map applies as soon as there is one.
heroicmap.ort.eigene.einzelspieler: Your own map then belongs to singleplayer.
heroicmap.ort.fehler.speicherstand: The name of the save is missing or ends with a dot.
heroicmap.ort.belegt: A download into one of these maps is running.
heroicmap.ort.fehler: The move failed; see the log for details.
heroicmap.ort.fehler.hash: The hash has exactly 16 hex digits: 0–9 and a–f, lower case.
heroicmap.ort.fehler.server: A server is named like a map: a–z, 0–9, _ and -, at most 64 characters.
heroicmap.ort.fehler.adresse: An address does not start with einzelspieler_, karte- or welt- and does not end with a dot.
heroicmap.auswahl.server.ohne_namen.besc: This server gives no name: neither the proxy nor karte.name in the plugin. Maps of all servers behind this address therefore share one folder per world. In the map list, “Move …” assigns a map to a server. For admins: karte.name in the plugin's config.
heroicmap.liste.nur_hier: You switch maps on or to resting only in the world you are in.
heroicmap.selbst.massstab.beschreibung: Pixels per block. More pixels show finer detail but take more disk space: 1, 2 and 4 px roughly as 1 : 4 : 16. Fixed until you delete the map in the map list.
heroicmap.selbst.frage: From now on the mod draws every chunk you load in this dimension at %s pixels per block into a map of its own for this world. The full map then shows only that map, not the server's. The scale stays until you delete the map in the map list; that is also how you stop it.
heroicmap.selbst.gewaehlt: The mod now draws the map itself.
heroicmap.selbst.geht_nicht: Drawing it yourself only works in a world and not under a ceiling.
heroicmap.selbst.fehler: The map to draw yourself could not be created; see the log for details.
heroicmap.befehl.welt_unbekannt: Enter %s first; only then does the mod know which world the map belongs to.
heroicmap.liste.frage_selbst: %s with %s will be removed from disk. Your own map starts over once you choose “Myself” again.
heroicmap.befehl.name: The mod does not accept %s as a map name; it asks for nothing.
heroicmap.selbst.schreibfehler: Your own map cannot be written, for example because the disk is full; it stops drawing until you change worlds. See the log for details.
heroicmap.menue.biom.name: name
heroicmap.menue.bei_f3.beschreibung: What the minimap does while the debug screen (F3) is open: stays where it is, hides, or moves to the middle of the screen, at the same height
heroicmap.rahmen.biom.beschreibung: Changes with the biome below you: forest, grassland, mountains, snow, desert, tropics, swamp or water.
heroicmap.waehler.titel: Frame – click a preview to use it, a colour to recolour it, Esc closes
heroicmap.menue.mitte: Middle mouse button: pixel, HD or see-through (now: %s)
heroicmap.rahmen.schild.beschreibung: Plain band with an N shield and bars as marks.
heroicmap.rahmen.rose.beschreibung: Fine line with compass-rose stars as marks.
heroicmap.rahmen.lettern.beschreibung: The cardinal letters N, E, S, W, always upright, inside or outside the frame.
heroicmap.menue.verzierungen.beschreibun: The N, E, S, W marks on the frame: fixed when north is up, turning with the map when it rotates. Off: bands or ring only.
heroicmap.menue.spieler.beschreibung: How you show on the minimap and the full map: head with arrow, the arrow alone, or the head half see-through with arrow.
heroicmap.menue.effekte.beschreibung: A beacon beam above each pinned waypoint and a veil along the edge of pinned regions
heroicmap.menue.schleier.beschreibung: How high the veil stands at the edge of your pinned regions; higher also means more opaque. Regions from the server stay at 4 blocks.
heroicmap.karte.verbinden_form: That shape is already in this connection
heroicmap.karte.form_zwei: At least two corners; Esc cancels
heroicmap.karte.koordinaten_hinweis: Enter: move here, x z, y does not count; Esc cancels
heroicmap.karte.koordinaten_belegt: There is already a waypoint there
heroicmap.karte.wegpunkt_bei_hinweis: Enter: set a waypoint at x z, y does not count; Esc cancels
heroicmap.menue.neue_version.beschreibun: Asks Modrinth at startup for the latest version of Heroic Map; Modrinth sees your IP
heroicmap.menue.todespunkt.beschreibung: When you die, the mod sets a waypoint where you died, pinning only the newest; it keeps this many and drops the oldest
heroicmap.karte.ebene_neu_hinweis: Enter: create a layer with this name and move it there; Esc cancels
heroicmap.ebenen.loeschen: Delete; what is in it goes to Base
heroicmap.ebenen.code.kein_code: The clipboard holds no Heroic Map code
heroicmap.ebenen.code.kaputt: The code is broken or incomplete
heroicmap.ebenen.code.version: The code comes from a newer version of the mod
heroicmap.ebenen.code.zu_viele: At most 256 waypoints and 256 shapes per code
heroicmap.ebenen.code.ebenen_voll: At most 32 layers of your own
heroicmap.ebenen.code.formen_voll: That many shapes no longer fit, at most 256 per world
heroicmap.karte.base_aus: New things go to Base, and Base is off; they show once you switch it on
heroicmap.karte.wegpunkt_verborgen: There is already a waypoint there, in a layer that is off
heroicmap.karte.neue_version.beschreibun: On Modrinth: %s, you have %s. Click: open page
heroicmap.web.kein_plugin: This server does not have the Heroic Map plugin
heroicmap.web.alt: The server's plugin can't do this yet
heroicmap.web.nicht_frei: Not enabled for you on this server
heroicmap.web.ohne_basis: The address of the web map is not known
heroicmap.web.oeffnet: The web map opens in your browser
heroicmap.web.adresse: The address of the web map is not allowed
heroicmap.web.browser: The browser could not be opened
heroicmap.web.grund.permission: The server does not allow you the web map
heroicmap.web.grund.webserver: The web map is not available on this server right now
heroicmap.web.grund.sonst: The server could not give a link
